vrf_common_errors.error_pattern: VRF Heat Pump Min/Max Operating Temperature in Cooling Mode Limits have been exceeded
vrf_common_errors.root_cause: Outdoor temperature falls outside the range specified in Fields 5-6
diagnosis_steps: 1. Check error message for actual outdoor temperature
2. Check System:VRF Field 5 (Min Cooling Temp)
3. Check System:VRF Field 6 (Max Cooling Temp)
4. Compare with climate data (weather file)

steps: 1. Set System:VRF Field 5 to -10°C or lower (was typically -6°C)

vrf_common_errors.prevention: Use wider temperature ranges by default: Field 5 = -10°C, Field 6 = 48°C
vrf_common_errors.impact: System will not cool when outdoor temp is outside range

vrf_common_errors.error_pattern: VRF Heat Pump Min/Max Operating Temperature in Heating Mode Limits have been exceeded

vrf_common_errors.error_pattern: COP must be > 0 even when capacity is autosized

3. Check Field 7 (Heating Capacity) - is it Autosize?

vrf_common_errors.prevention: Always set COP fields to realistic values (3.5-4.5) even when capacity is autosized
